blocks.html: Committed to help protect the environment, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) recently turned-over its fund donation to the Parent- Teacher Association of Cansuje National High School in Argao, Cebu. Argao is one of Robinsons Galleria Cebu’s neighboring communities and is known for its bountiful nature, famous Bugasok falls and the 300 year old church of St. Michael the Archangel.

Believing in the long term benefits and sustainability of this green endeavor with Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), RLC’s donation shall provide resources for the construction of nursery facilities that will raise 40,000 seedlings of fruit-bearing trees and endemic forest tree species.
